scope: All 249 public ggml.h functions returning a ggml_tensor pointer. The table maps the 236 tensor or operation constructors to source definitions, local assertion/abort sites and opcode families. A wrapper that constructs a graph maps to each primitive family it calls. An explicit assignment identifies the resulting operation. The other 13 entries retrieve or modify existing tensors.
validation_scope: Source inventory. Execution evidence is recorded independently in the factory and supplemental verdicts. FLASH_ATTN_BACK aborts before graph construction.
